description: Adds partial-eta-squared, omega-squared, Kendall's W, post-hoc power, and MDE at 80% power to the CRES-5 effect-size battery.

fleiss_kappa.notes: Fleiss' kappa used instead of Kendall's W. Kendall's W is degenerate on heavily-tied binary data — the tie-correction term turns the denominator negative at this scale (n=14,826, k=4). Fleiss' kappa is the appropriate k-rater categorical agreement statistic. Observed P_o = 0.5542 is only marginally above chance, consistent with CRES-12's mean pairwise Spearman rho = 0.060.

power_analysis.interpretation: With n=14826 episodes and k=4 evaluators, any eta2 >= 0.00018 is detectable at alpha=0.05 and 80% power. Observed eta2=0.0725 therefore easily clears the detection threshold; the 'small' effect size is substantive, not a power artefact.
